peripheral.name: PHY_I2C_COMMAND_RAM
peripheral.description: SOURCE[ESP_IDF_ESP32S31_MODEM_REG_BASE,BLOB_LIBPHY_PHY_I2C,BLOB_LIBPHY_PHY_DEBUG_I2C]; CONFIDENCE[instruction-exact]. Official S31 reg_base.h names this aperture DR_REG_I2C_ANA_MST_MEM_BASE. The complete blob establishes its forty-five-entry command layout and the population order in phy_i2c_master_cmd_mem_init. Complete phy_i2c_check independently names ten logical banks, their block IDs, selected host and finite register-index ranges.

register.name: COMMAND_MEMORY%s
register.description: SOURCE[ESP_IDF_ESP32S31_MODEM_REG_BASE,BLOB_LIBPHY_PHY_I2C]; CONFIDENCE[instruction-exact]. One PHY-I2C master command-memory entry; the public header proves the containing memory aperture while the complete blob proves this word layout.

field.name: BLOCK
field.description: SOURCE[BLOB_LIBPHY_PHY_DEBUG_I2C]; CONFIDENCE[instruction-exact]. Logical PHY-I2C block ID. The bank host and valid half-open register-index ranges are: SAR1 host 0 [0,7), ULP host 1 [0,11), RFPLL host 1 [0,22), RFPLL_SDM host 1 [0,7), BBPLL host 0 [0,11), BBTOP host 1 [0,57), PERIF host 0 [0,13), BIAS host 1 [0,4), TXRF host 1 [1,22), DIG_REG host 0 [0,15).
